svg.title: xuanlam2007/RPGAttackSystem
svg.desc: RPGAttackSystem: RPGAttackSystem brings a true RPG-style attack rhythm to Minecraft (Paper 1.21+). It integrates with the vanilla cooldown bar, ensuring players time their melee strikes, encouraging more tactical combat.. 1 stars, 0 forks, Kotlin.
